descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și mass-media și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
As a Systems Engineer, you will keep a high-traffic, real-time video platform fast, available and secure. You will run production across our own hardware, OpenStack private cloud and Kubernetes clusters, and own the platform that every engineering team at Smart-X builds and ships on.
 This is a hands-on role: you will design and automate infrastructure, improve reliability and performance, and understand systems down to the kernel, network and database level.
 Responsibilities 
Keep production reliable and fast: handle alerts and incidents, remove bottlenecks, plan capacity, maintain backups, and disaster recovery.
Operate bare-metal servers, an OpenStack/KVM private cloud and CDN edge nodes across several data centres; patch, harden and upgrade Linux fleets.
Run networking (BGP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls, VPN) and work with hosting and network providers.
Run and upgrade Kubernetes clusters; maintain CI/CD pipelines and development environments.
Manage infrastructure as code and GitOps deployments with Terraform, Ansible, Helm and ArgoCD.
Operate databases and message brokers in production: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, NATS.
Own monitoring and alerting, access management, and security compliance.
Support engineering teams with infrastructure requests.
Take part in the on-call rotation.
 Requirements 
4+ years running Linux servers in production, with strong troubleshooting skills.
Solid networking: TCP/IP, routing, DNS, load balancing, firewalls.
Hands-on Kubernetes in production.
Database operations (MySQL, PostgreSQL): replication, backups and restores, performance tuning.
Infrastructure as code with Terraform and/or Ansible.
Monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.
Scripting in Bash plus Python or Go.
On-call experience.
 Nice to have 
OpenStack / KVM and BGP in production.
Video streaming and CDN delivery (HLS, caching at high packet rates).
MongoDB, Ceph or other distributed storage.
Identity and access tooling (OIDC/SAML).
 What we offer 
Ownership of a large-scale production platform.
A tight-knit team that works closely together, shares knowledge openly and owns problems end to end.
Location / work model: Remote.
